fills.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT (matches the row-specific dispatch caution): Owner1='Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC' is sourced from EIA's Pipeline Operator Name field per ADDENDUM rule 5 -- this covers Owner1 ONLY, at medium (single EIA origin for that specific attribution). The underlying JV equity holders were located via EQT Corporation's FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-18, the MVP-mainline-relevant parent post the July 2024 Equitrans Midstream acquisition): 'Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC (the MVP Joint Venture) ... has three series ... Series A (MVP A), which owns MVP Mainline.' As of 2025-12-31, EQT (via the consolidated 'Midstream Joint Venture', in which an affiliate of Blackstone Credit & Insurance holds a noncontrolling interest) held a 49.3% ownership interest in MVP A -- this is the only individually-disclosed percentage in the 10-K. 'MVP A's members consisted of the Midstream Joint Venture and affiliates of each of NextEra Energy, Inc., Con Edison Gas Pipeline and Storage, LLC (ConEd), AltaGas Ltd., and RGC Resources, Inc.' -- their individual splits of the remaining ~50.7% are NOT disclosed in this filing beyond ConEd's own stake, which the 10-K separately states was ~6.60% before a Jan 2026 partial buyout (EQT acquiring ~3.94%, NextEra acquiring the remaining ~2.66%, expected to close 1H2026, so ConEd's post-transaction stake in MVP A approaches 0%). NextEra, AltaGas and RGC's individual percentages were not found in this 10-K or elsewhere searched (EQT's exhibit index, ConEd/Con Edison's own SEC filings were not checked -- a genuine gap, noted rather than guessed). Owner1%/Owner3%/Owner4%/Owner5% left blank pending that further research; Owner2 (EQT, 49.3%) is the only individually-sourced percentage. Two independent hosts (EIA + EQT's own 10-K) corroborate that Mountain Valley Pipeline LLC / EQT-affiliated JV is the owner; tier=medium overall because the granular percentages beyond EQT's 49.3% rest on a single filing. Owner1 is written 'Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'Mountain Valley Pipeline LLC'.

Its Q1 2026 earnings call independently repeats the same fact in a separate document ('Stonewall Mountain Valley pipeline expansion that was placed into service at the beginning of February'), and Oil & Gas Journal (Nov 2024) independently corroborates the underlying project and its 1H2026 target. Sheet's current 'proposed' status is stale as of at least 2026-02-01 and should change to 'operating'.
